title: Loyalty points accrue only when rent is Completed AND payment is Paid
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual Conditions
  Scenario: Points accrue when both Completed rent and Paid payment status exist
    Given a user has completed a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "Completed"
    And the payment status is "Paid"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance shall increase
    And the balance update shall be recorded immediately

  Scenario: Points do not accrue when rent is Completed but payment is not Paid
    Given a user has a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "Completed"
    And the payment status is "Pending"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance shall not change

  Scenario: Points do not accrue when payment is Paid but rent is not Completed
    Given a user has a rent transaction
    And the rent status is "In Progress"
    And the payment status is "Paid"
    When the loyalty points accrual process runs
    Then the user's loyalty point balance shall not change
rationale: The operative context explicitly states loyalty points accrue only when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid. This test validates the dual-condition requirement and ensures points are not awarded under partial conditions, maintaining consistency in loyalty currency accrual.
usedContextItems: System shall allow users to earn loyalty points based on completed rents with Completed rent status and Paid payment status|Loyalty points accrual only applies when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid

From: finance_director@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-03-03 11:00
Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.
